usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), Senegal, 2025 average
usdRate.note: 581.93 CFA francs per dollar on average in 2025; the BCEAO reference rate was 584.84 on 2 November 2026. The franc is fixed at 655.957 per euro.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Agence nationale de la Statistique et de la Démographie (ANSD), Indice harmonisé des prix à la consommation, September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 1.0% year on year in September 2026 (1.2% in August per the BCEAO); core inflation also 1.0%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCEAO inflation target band of 1-3%; CFA franc pegged to the euro
inflation_projection.note: Senegal's inflation has stayed low under the euro peg (1.0% in September 2026), so the 2% centre of the BCEAO's 1-3% target band is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, Note de conjoncture économique des pays de l'UEMOA, September 2026 (Monetary Policy Committee of 9 September 2026)
policy_rate.note: Main policy rate held at 3.00% (marginal lending facility 5.00%) by the Monetary Policy Committee on 9 September 2026; common to all eight UMOA countries.

savings_account_rate.note: No average rate on ordinary savings accounts in Senegal was found; the BCEAO bank-conditions survey (first half 2026) lists term-deposit and contractual-savings rates only.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Senegal)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Median of the minimum term-deposit rates (taux DAT minimum) declared to the BCEAO by the 29 Senegalese credit institutions that reported one, range 0-5%; the minimum usually applies to small, short deposits. Not a tenor-specific average.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BCEAO bank-conditions survey gives only minimum (median 3.5%) and maximum (median about 6.5%, range 3.5-7.51%) term-deposit rates per institution in Senegal for the first half of 2026, not a 1-year rate.

dps_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Senegal) (épargne contractuelle)
dps_rate.note: Median rate on contractual savings plans declared by Senegalese credit institutions in the first half of 2026; most declare 3.50% (range about 3.5-4.75%).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, Note de conjoncture économique des pays de l'UEMOA, September 2026 (bank deposit rates, July 2026)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average deposit rate across UMOA banks, 5.15% in July 2026; Senegal's rose 0.26 points in the month, but the BCEAO does not publish the country level in this note. The World Bank series for Senegal stops in 2016 (6.9%).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The State sells bonds to the public by public offering (appel public à l'épargne), but the rate of a current issue could not be confirmed from an official page.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres (UEMOA public securities agency), Senegal yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3-month zero-coupon rate 6.27% (6.95% after smoothing); 1-year 8.15%. Yields are high because of Senegal's debt difficulties since 2024.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres (UEMOA public securities agency), Senegal yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres (UEMOA public securities agency), Senegal yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Senegal, corporate withholding taxes (reviewed 7 August 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: 8% withholding on interest from deposits and bank accounts; 16% on other interest such as loans.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Senegal, corporate withholding taxes (reviewed 7 August 2026)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Bond interest is taxed at 6% for bonds of 5 years or more and 13% under 5 years; individual public bond issues may carry their own exemptions, which were not checked.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: UMOA Council of Ministers, Decision of 30 June 2017 on FGD-UMOA contribution rates and compensation ceilings
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposits are guaranteed up to 1,400,000 FCFA per depositor per bank (300,000 FCFA at a microfinance institution) by the regional deposit guarantee fund; the decision dates from 2017 (older than 2025), and no later change was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions débitrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Senegal)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Median maximum lending rate (taux débiteur maximum) declared by Senegal's 27 banks for the first half of 2026 (range 7-14%); it applies to all bank credit, including cards. No card-specific rate is published.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM); UMOA-Titres Senegal yield curve
equity_return_low.note: Low case: regional (BRVM) equities return about the bank deposit rate, as in their weak 2016-2020 years.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026; after-tax deposit rate about 4.7% (5.15% less 8% tax)
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.3 points above the after-tax deposit rate, within the 4-point cap; Senegal shares trade on the regional BRVM, whose 10-year record is mixed.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM)
equity_return_high.note: High case: the BRVM repeats a strong decade like 2023-2026.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO reference rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro); dollar gold trend
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO reference rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro); dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus a small allowance for the euro-pegged franc weakening against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BCEAO reference rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years such as 2024-2025.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Senegal)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at about 3.5%, less the 8% tax on interest.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO: UMOA average deposit rate 5.15% (July 2026) less 8% tax; Senegal 1-year bill 8.15%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at about the Union average rate after tax (about 4.7%), rounded down.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres (UEMOA public securities agency), Senegal yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 3-5 year Treasury bonds at about 8%, less 6-13% tax and an allowance for Senegal's higher credit risk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: CIMA (the regional insurance regulator) and Senegal's insurance directorate publish no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Temporary death cover is sold under the CIMA code, but no published premium rates per 1,000 FCFA of cover by age were found from a public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Senegal was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Senegal
oop_health_share.note: 44.3% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: ANSD IHPC September 2026: health prices +2.0% a year; 2% planning inflation
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices rose 2.0% in the past year, but private and imported care tends to rise faster, so 1.5 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education price trend was read beyond the monthly note; private school fees usually rise faster than general prices, so 2 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Senegal

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; the both-sexes figure at 65 is published, the others are the mean of men and women.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+ = 100 / old-age dependency ratio. Dependency ratios used: 6.22 per 100 in 2025 (World Bank), 7.4 in 2040 (populationpyramid.net/senegal/2040/) and 14.6 in 2065 (populationpyramid.net/senegal/2065/, UN WPP 2024 medium variant).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: US Social Security Administration, Social Security Programs Throughout the World: Africa, 2019, Senegal (archived copy)
retirement_age_default.note: IPRES general-scheme pension at 55 to 60 depending on the type of employment (55 for arduous work), with at least 400 points; 60 is the normal age for most employees, early pension from 53 with a 5% cut per year. Secondary source read through the Internet Archive (ssa.gov and the IPRES site could not be reached); 2019 edition, older than 2025.

retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants have a separate scheme (Fonds National de Retraite); their retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source (the fund's site could not be reached).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Senegal)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at about 3.5%, less the 8% tax on interest.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO: UMOA average deposit rate 5.15% (July 2026) less 8% tax = about 4.7%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the after-tax deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres (UEMOA public securities agency), Senegal yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026
retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in Treasury bonds or public bond offers held to maturity.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Senegal)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about after-tax deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Senegal yield curve; regional equity and gold assumptions above
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits or Treasury bonds, regional equity funds and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Senegal yield curve; regional equity and gold assumptions above

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age cash pension was found; people aged 60 and over get free care in public health facilities under Plan Sésame (US SSA 2019), which is not a cash benefit, and family security grants go to poor households, not to older people as such.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age cash pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: No official text on a statutory end-of-service or retirement indemnity for private employees could be read (the Labour Code and the interprofessional collective agreement were not reached), so the rule is unconfirmed.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: US Social Security Administration, Social Security Programs Throughout the World: Africa, 2019, Senegal (archived copy)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory IPRES points scheme for private-sector employees and non-civil-servant public employees: pension = points x point value set each year by IPRES, payable at 55-60 depending on employment, with at least 400 points (early from 53); a lump sum below 400 points. Point values are set by IPRES rather than indexed automatically, so inflationLinked is false. Civil servants have a separate scheme. 2019 edition, older than 2025.

savings_account.note: Banks offer savings accounts; no average rate is published.

fdr_3m.note: Minimum term-deposit rates of 0-5% declared to the BCEAO (first half 2026, median 3.5%).

fdr_1y.note: Maximum term-deposit rates of 3.5-7.51% declared to the BCEAO (first half 2026); no 1-year average is published.

dps.note: Contractual savings at about 3.50% (BCEAO bank-conditions survey, first half 2026).

sanchayapatra_5y.localName: Emprunt obligataire de l'État par appel public à l'épargne
sanchayapatra_5y.localNameEn: Government bond sold to the public
sanchayapatra_5y.note: State bonds offered to individuals through licensed brokers and banks; the rate of a current issue could not be confirmed.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned through UMOA-Titres to banks and primary dealers; individuals buy through a bank or broker.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned through UMOA-Titres; individuals buy through a bank or broker.

tbond_10y.note: Senegal's yield curve extends to 15 years; individuals buy through a bank or broker.

equity_fund.note: Funds regulated by the regional financial markets authority invest in shares listed on the regional exchange (BRVM).

gold.note: Gold is sold mainly as jewellery; no official bullion or coin scheme was found.

centralBank.name: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)

insuranceRegulator.name: Commission Régionale de Contrôle des Assurances (CIMA)
insuranceRegulator.note: Regional insurance regulator for the CIMA member states, Senegal included.

insuranceComplaints.name: CIMA policyholder requests and complaints form

pensionScheme.name: Institution de Prévoyance Retraite du Sénégal (IPRES)
pensionScheme.note: The site could not be reached when checked.

publicHealthCover.name: Agence de la Couverture Maladie Universelle (CMU), including Plan Sésame for people aged 60 and over
publicHealthCover.note: The site could not be reached when checked.

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution dans l'UMOA (FGDR-UMOA)

statistics.name: Agence nationale de la Statistique et de la Démographie (ANSD)
